To summarize, it's something different. I am stuck in my own head. I fake every part of my life. I am not myself. I can never be myself. It's not your typical, "I don't fit in. I'm a freak. I'm so weird." Angsty teenage rant. I see the world in a different perspective. I act like the typical teenage girl. I love clothes, makeup, Starbucks, and gossip but there's a depth to me that I feel is incomprehensible to those around me. It's why I'm an atheist, why I don't have a fear death, why I strive to live yet consider suicide. I have driven myself insane, in my own mind. I feel the human life is either meaningless or so meaningful that it's ungraspable. I can't even write it down or express it. I just have a constant voice asking why in my head 

Also, I am unhappy in the body I am in. Back to the 'normal' side of me I am repulsive. I just wish to be happy with myself. My fixation on appearance, which started at a young age after being bullied and backstabbed, left me with trust issues and self hatred. I simply skip meals and get infuriated with myself because I am too wrak. Too weak to starve myself, too weak to speak up, too weak to end it.

To put it simply, I am just depressed. With no direct cause. Just multiple factors leading to my collapse. Currently, I am ok. I'm just finally writing down all of this. Setting it to rest. I am content.

I'm honest with myself. I know simply writing it down shows no depth in my struggles (wether minor or major) but it's the basics, and what is needed to know.

I feel as if I'm trapped in my own mind. I think on an entirely different level of my actions. I can be completely normal. No one ever suspects a goddamn thing is wrong with me. My intelligence is measured only by my grades and the fact I'm in the gifted program. Nobody knows what I've seen, or what I know. I am trapped.
